[DaTa] Chocolate or straight up are the best :)

[The Guitar Hero] Struggled to finish 1 L, would recommend trying before committing to 6L.
[Ian2578] Did you watch 4 Corners on ABC on 27 July?

[mostlygordon] I think it was the episode that only had 3 viewers;-)
[bisaya] curious, what's the relevance to this deal?
I see it's about an hour, would rather not watch for an hour so if you could share why that episode is relevant, let me know. ty
[iceman24what] Coconut water was a category identified as prone to fraud worldwide, usually through dilution with plain water or undeclared added sugars such as cane, corn, or starch syrup. UK, Brazilian, and Chinese testing using isotope fingerprinting found undeclared water or sugar in most “100% coconut water” samples checked.
[imahippy] The coffee one tastes a little strange. But choc is epic
[VehemenceThePhoenix] I loved the coffee one, but quite a lot of sugar.
[PissLUR] Chocolate is $16.50 on Amazon Business. no S&S.
